headline: Global Atlantic Featured in Barron’s 100 Best Annuities Guide
summary: NEW YORK, July 27, 2026--Global Atlantic, a leading provider of retirement security and investment solutions and a wholly-owned subsidiary of KKR, announced its inclusion in Barron’s annual 100 Best Annuities guide, marking the firm’s fifth consecutive year of recognition. This year's rankings reflect the strength of Global Atlantic’s product lineup and continued focus on delivering innovative retirement products designed to meet the evolving needs of today’s investors.
